text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Training time comes around, but I don't see Narita Taishin, so I decide to go looking for her.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! That was an easy win! The arcade and mobile versions of this game are practically the same.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aww yeah! I'm on fire! Just gotta keep this streak going!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Who the heck is this "MightyMe" anyways? They're relentless!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: We're pretty evenly matched, so why do I keep losing? Dammit! I'm winning the next round if it kills me!
choice_data_list: Um, Taishin… You coming to training?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She apologizes, and I tell her to be more careful from now on.
